crossRefs.note: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds…
He said to them, “What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day…
Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.
Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more…
For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen…
or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope…

parallels.note: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

translations.web: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.
translations.bsb: So do not be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
translations.kjv: Fear ye not therefore, ye are of more value than many sparrows.
translations.asv: Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
